purpose: Scaled-space Earth relief for visual continuity above the local Starbase/Kennedy terrain handoff.

source.name: ETOPO 2022 Global Relief Model
source.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
source.coverage: global land topography and ocean bathymetry

derived_asset.source_nodata_policy: must be inspected during conversion; do not silently invent terrain

runtime_contract.near_field_authority: site-specific NAIP/3DEP terrain remains authoritative below the scaled-Earth handoff
acceptance: source checksum is recorded after download
derived texture dimensions and uint16 encoding are verified
no seam at longitude wrap or latitude poles
real 1920x1080 framebuffer captures show relief continuity at 20, 50, 100 and 500 km
terrain asset does not alter simulation gravity, mass, collision or flight telemetry

notes: The raw global dataset is intentionally not committed to the repository.
ETOPO is a global backdrop source, not a substitute for launch-site photogrammetry or a collision mesh.
The derived range preserves Earth land and ocean relief while keeping the runtime texture bounded and streamable.
